ideas.pitch: Satellite-based industrial and environmental risk compliance monitoring dashboard tailored for Montreal's port and industrial sectors.
ideas.title: MontrealLocalRiskMap
ideas.why_it_could_win: Follows the exact pattern of GeoNex-ATLAS by applying satellite monitoring and compliance tracking to a localized industrial use case.

ideas.pitch: AI-powered nutrition platform that integrates local grocery inventories in Montreal to generate budget-friendly healthy meal plans.
ideas.title: QuebecAgriNutri
ideas.why_it_could_win: Builds directly on the E-Foodiee win by adding localized supermarket supply chain data to make the health recommendations actionable.

ideas.pitch: Multi-agent student support and campus sustainability platform designed for Montreal universities to track and reduce energy waste.
ideas.title: EcoCampusAgent
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the winning formula of the greennovation-ai-platform by combining multi-agent LangGraph workflows with localized campus utility data.

ideas.pitch: AI-driven patient acquisition, appointment triage, and trust-building engine specifically customized for specialized clinics in Quebec.
ideas.title: LocalProsthoTrust
ideas.why_it_could_win: Replicates the Global-Smile prize-winning approach by solving a high-value niche for local medical professionals with an immediate ROI pitch.

ideas.pitch: AWS-powered graph intelligence and AML risk detection platform for regional fintech startups monitoring supply chain transactions.
ideas.title: MontrealSupplyGraph
ideas.why_it_could_win: Matches the technically rigorous approach of Bito, emphasizing graph-based anomaly detection that appeals to technical judges.
